decision_rule.formula: score = source_gate * lift_gate * wind_align_gate * dry_precip_gate * transport_gate
decision_rule.computed_consequence: counterfactual score below 1 means the source-gate test fails

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the required label, both scores, source flag count, dry-precipitation count, transport distance, and annual-change ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when the calculation is recoverable but one field is missing or renamed unclearly.

criteria.name: Source and lifting gates
criteria.description: Counts all five observed source-chain indicators and forms the observed source, lift, and wind-alignment gates correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for a partial source-chain count or for omitting one of the lift or wind-alignment gates.

criteria.name: Precipitation and transport thresholds
criteria.description: Applies the <=0.1 mm event-day mean threshold to both precipitation products and the >=120 km threshold to the report-context transport lower bound.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for using the right variables with one threshold, rounding, or count error.

criteria.name: Multiplicative proof
criteria.description: Uses score = source_gate * lift_gate * wind_align_gate * dry_precip_gate * transport_gate, giving observed_chain_score = 1 and counterfactual_chain_score = 0.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points if the formula is described but one score is wrong or the counterfactual source gate is not forced to zero.

criteria.name: Timing check
criteria.description: Reports the annual surface-change max-to-mean ratio near 17.16 and treats it as a year-scale timing check.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for computing the ratio but overstating its role in the event-day gate.

criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.description: Uses the fail label only because the counterfactual score is below the pass score of 1.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right label without a clear score comparison.

criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.description: Keeps the final sentence to the computed source-gate consequence and does not add impact or process narration.
criteria.partial_credit: Award no more than 1 point here for any prose-only explanation.

provenance.notes: All values are parsed from local CSX-299 package records.
